comments.author: maxbond
comments.story: Wagner leader Yevgeny Prigozhin listed as passenger on plane which crashed
comments.why: Shows the airframe parachute in action
comments.text: Perhaps some private planes (Cirrus) are better equipped to survive losing a wing, since they have rocket-deployed parachutes. Somewhat boring video of the parachute in action ("boring" being a synonym for "an amazing triumph of safety engineering"): [VIDEO] 14m video essay about the system: [LINK] (Reporting says this was an Embraer, this is strictly a tangent.)

comments.story: Cirrus Vision Jet Pilot Pulls Chute in Florida
comments.why: Previous CAPS landing over water showing a rough touchdown
comments.text: I you watch the video of a previous CAPS landing over water, the landings can still be a bit rough: [VIDEO] But obviously 10x better than the alternative.

comments.author: markab21
comments.story: Pilots who risk their lives flying tiny planes over the Atlantic
comments.why: Coast Guard footage of a parachute ditching and rescue
comments.text: There was another incident like that too, a guy tried to make it to Hawaii and calculated he'd not make it because of headwinds and had to ditch. He deployed his airframe parachute in the plane and was picked up by a life boat from a cruise ship. Here is the coastguard video of the event: [VIDEO]
